text: dsh-plugin-readme-zh（DSH Web 插件）：将已安装插件的说明文档翻译为简体中文。它在插件详情页加入中文说明对话框，按 Markdown 段落分块调用模型或翻译服务，并用持久缓存复用未变更内容；还可选择为插件列表行写入中文 locale sidecar。适合希望直接阅读插件中文文档的 DSH Web 用户。列表行翻译需显式开启 metaSidecars。

dsh-plugin-readme-zh translates installed plugin documentation into Simplified Chinese. Its DSH Web detail dialog translates Markdown chunks through a model or translator service and caches results. An optional mode writes Chinese locale sidecars for plugin list rows.
想在 DSH 的插件详情页直接看中文说明。
能不能把已安装插件的英文文档翻译成简体中文并记住结果？
I want Chinese descriptions for plugin rows in the DSH web plugin list.
dsh-plugin-readme-zh 的功能「插件说明翻译」：在插件详情页打开“中文说明”对话框，将文档分段翻译成简体中文并显示进度；用户可复制译文、重新翻译或批量翻译已安装插件。
dsh-plugin-readme-zh 的功能「列表行中文 sidecar」：启用 metaSidecars 后，翻译已安装插件列表中的标题和描述，并将结果写入对应包的 locale 文件，供 DSH 正常语言解析显示。

dsh-plugin-readme-zh README · Chinese Plugin Docs：English | 中文（由本插件自动翻译）

Translate the documentation of any installed plugin on the Plugins page into Simplified Chinese — both the long detail document and the list-row title/description one-liners — keep every result in a persistent cache, and re-translate only the parts a plugin update actually changes.

dsh-plugin-readme-zh README · Summary：DSH plugins ship their user documentation as an English README (or a `meta.detail` document), and their list rows show the bundle's `meta.title` / `meta.description` with a literal English fallback. This bundle does two things:

dsh-plugin-readme-zh README · Summary：1. Adds a **中文说明** control to the head of every installed plugin's detail page. The control opens a dialog with the translated long document, live progress, and cache statistics.
2. Makes the **Plugins list itself render Chinese**: it translates each bundle's short one-line meta and writes the result into the bundle's own locale files, so the host's normal locale resolution displays it natively — no client-side DOM patching.

dsh-plugin-readme-zh README · Summary：All translations are produced by the model selected as the agent default (or an explicitly configured provider and model), and are stored under `$DSH_HOME/plugin-data/dsh-plugin-readme-zh/` (Markdown segments plus short strings).

dsh-plugin-readme-zh README · Use this plugin：1. Install the bundle. On every start it automatically translates the list one-liners of all installed plugins (in the background; already-cached strings cost nothing).
2. Open **Settings → Plugins**: installed rows now show Chinese one-line descriptions next to their package names.
3. Open any installed plugin's detail page; its header shows a **中文说明** button. Select it.
4. On first use the document is translated and the dialog shows a progress bar. Later visits read the cache and open instantly.
5. **重新翻译** forces a fresh translation. **翻译全部已安装插件** translates every installed plugin's long document in the background (and refreshes the list one-liners too); progress appears beside the button.
6. **复制中文** copies the translated Markdown.
dsh-plugin-readme-zh README · Use this plugin：The detail button is hidden when the plugin has no readable document, its files are unavailable, or its document is already Chinese.

dsh-plugin-readme-zh README · How the list rows become Chinese：Opt-in via `metaSidecars: true` (off by default). When enabled, for each profile-installed bundle the translations are kept in its own package directory:

text: dsh-plugin-readme-zh README · How the list rows become Chinese：These are small, additive, idempotent writes into the installed package's own directory; a `pnpm install` that re-extracts the package simply resets it, and the next start re-applies it from the string cache.

text: dsh-plugin-readme-zh README · Configuration：Set these fields on the bundle row in the profile patch when the defaults do not fit:

dsh-plugin-readme-zh README · Configuration：| Field | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `engine` | `auto` | `auto` prefers the model service and falls back to the translator service; `llm` requires a model; `translator` uses only `ctx.translator`. |
| `provider` | agent default | Model provider route for translation. |
| `model` | agent default | Model id for translation. |
| `reasoningEffort` | `off` when supported | Reasoning effort for the translation call. |
| `maxTokens` | `8192` | Output-token cap per chunk. |
| `translatorProvider` | `bing` | Provider used when the translator fallback runs. |
| `metaSidecars` | `false` | Opt-in: also write the translated list-row one-liners into the installed packages' own `locale/` files (plus one standard `exports` entry where needed) so the Plugins list renders Chinese natively. **Off by default** — a public install keeps its hands off other packages. Set `true` to enable the list-row feature. |

dsh-plugin-readme-zh README · Configuration：The translation prompt requires the model to preserve Markdown syntax, code, URLs, file paths, package names, and identifiers, and to return only the translated fragment.

dsh-plugin-readme-zh README · Limitations：- The long detail document and the list-row one-line meta are translated; deep configuration field labels, row titles, and in-document strings stay in their original language.
- The first translation of a long document needs one model call per chunk; a 30 KB README usually takes a handful of calls.
- Transient model failures are retried on the model itself (three attempts with backoff). Only a structural failure (no provider, missing credentials, exceeded context window) uses the anonymous translator fallback, and that decision is made per chunk.
- A chunk that is almost entirely code or symbols and still comes back without Chinese text is kept verbatim and counted under `keptSource`; it stays that way on later runs of an unchanged document.
- A translated document is stored as a whole; editing the cached file by hand is not supported.
- The dialog renders Markdown with a deliberately small renderer. Raw HTML is reduced to its text content, external images are shown as their alt text, and links are limited to HTTP(S), `mailto:`, and in-page anchors.
- The list-row translation (writing `locale/*.json` sidecars and one `exports` entry) is **o
dsh-plugin-readme-zh README · Distribution：The package is a plain DSH bundle with no npm dependencies of its own, so any of these work:

dsh-plugin-readme-zh README · Distribution：| Route | How | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| **Tarball (offline)** | `npm pack` → share the `.tgz` → install with `dsh plugin --profile <name> add file:/abs/path/<name>.tgz` | Needs no registry and no network. This is the route used on machines where GitHub and the npm website are unreachable. |
| **Local directory** | `dsh plugin --profile <name> add link:/abs/path/dsh-plugin-readme-zh` | Live edits are picked up on reload; used during development. |
| **npm registry** | `npm publish --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org/`, then `dsh plugin --profile <name> add <package-name>` | Requires an npm account created through the website; a mirror such as `registry.npmmirror.com` cannot publish. |
| **Git repository** | `dsh plugin --profile <name> add git+https://github.com/<owner>/<repo>` | The bundle reads its files from a checkout; needs reachable GitHub. |

dsh-plugin-readme-zh README · Distribution：After any of these, enable the bundle in the Plugins page (or add it to `dsh.profile.bundles`) and set `metaSidecars: true` if the list-row translation is wanted.

dsh-plugin-readme-zh README · Verification：The bundle was checked through static syntax checks and unit tests of the Markdown splitter (code fences, tables, HTML blocks, and long prose all round-trip exactly) plus live checks in the running Web profile: the routes answer on `/api/plugin-readme-zh` and its `/v1` alias, the **中文说明** control appears on installed plugin detail pages, and the list-row meta sidecars were confirmed by the loader reporting `skipped` (already-Chinese) for every profile bundle.

dsh-plugin-readme-zh README · Troubleshooting：- When the **中文说明** control is missing, the plugin has no readable document, its files are unavailable, or its document is already Chinese.
- When a list row still shows English after an update, the package was re-extracted by pnpm; the next DSH start (or **翻译全部已安装插件**) re-applies the cached translation and re-writes its locale sidecar.
- When translation fails, the dialog shows the model provider failure. Setting `engine: translator` switches to the anonymous translation service.
- The first run performs one model call per segment; later runs reuse every unchanged segment.
- The translated document is rendered with the same Markdown structure, and code blocks are never translated.
